requirements.value: Applicant must hold a valid license from another state/possession/DC with substantially equivalent standards as determined by the board, pay the requisite fee, and submit a completed application; or be licensed in RI as a state certified real estate appraiser or to practice architecture or professional engineering and meet moral character, high school, and exam requirements.
requirements.quote: Upon payment to the board of the requisite fee and submission of a completed application approved by the board, the board shall issue a home inspector license to any person who: (1) Holds a valid license issued by another state or possession of the United States or the District of Columbia that has standards substantially equivalent to those of this state as determined by the board

is_mandatory.quote: Any person who conducts a home inspection as defined by this chapter shall be licensed pursuant to this chapter

title_protection.quote: No person, not licensed as a home inspector or associate home inspector, shall advertise or hold himself or herself out as a home inspector, or impersonate a home inspector or associate home inspector.

scope_protection.quote: Any person who operates as a home inspector without a license as adjudged in a final order issued by the board, upon proper written notification, is deemed guilty of a misdemeanor

disciplinary_grounds.quote: Accepted commissions or allowances, directly or indirectly, from other parties dealing with his or her client in connection with the inspection for which the licensee is responsible;

insurance_required.quote: Every licensed home inspector and associate home inspector shall secure, maintain, and file with the board a certificate of insurance for an errors and omissions policy and a certificate of insurance for a general liability policy; both shall be for a minimum amount of five hundred thousand dollars ($500,000) in the aggregate.

eligibility for licensure as associate home inspector

definition_quote.value: an inspection and a written evaluation of the following readily visible and accessible components of a residential building: heating, cooling, plumbing, and electrical systems, structural components, foundation, roof, masonry structure, exterior and interior components, and any other related residential housing components
definition_quote.quote: "Home inspection" means an inspection and a written evaluation of the following readily visible and accessible components of a residential building: heating, cooling, plumbing, and electrical systems, structural components, foundation, roof, masonry structure, exterior and interior components, and any other related residential housing components

value: visual inspection of readily visible and accessible components
methods_authorized.quote: based solely on observation of the readily visible and apparent condition of the foregoing components of a residential building as they exist on the date of the inspection

license_tier.quote: "Home inspector" means any person licensed as a home inspector to conduct a home inspection of a residential building on behalf of a client for a fee pursuant to the provisions of this chapter.

trainee_intern_registration_required.quote: "Associate home inspector" means a person who is employed by a licensed home inspector to conduct a home inspection of a residential building on behalf of a client for a fee under the direct supervision of the licensed home inspector and is licensed pursuant to the provisions of this chapter.

minimum_inspections_for_licensure.quote: have performed not less than one hundred (100) home inspections for compensation

liability_waiver_clauses_void.quote: No contract provided by any licensed home inspector or associate home inspector shall contractually limit the liability of any such inspector to any amount less than the limits of insurance specified in subsection (a). Any such limitation provision in any home inspection contract issued on or after September 1, 2016, shall be void.

entity_license_required.quote: No corporation, firm, association, or partnership shall engage in business as a home inspector or represent itself as an inspection company unless a licensed home inspector as provided in this chapter is continuously engaged in the supervision of its inspections.
